visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames. The individual two-tower cathedral has tall tiered square campaniles with four open stages, a solid clock stage, paired upper arches, shallow terracotta caps and crosses. The left-of-front tower has clock hands; the other has a blank circular field, following the inspected 2025 exterior. A raised red-tiled nave with paired round clerestory windows, lower aisle roofs, transverse gabled crossing, rounded rear apse and low side ranges retains the current map outline. The front has a round rose, white-edged gables, a genuinely open arched porch, closed wood doors and broad entry steps. Corrected a tiny tile-quantization spike that caused a hipped porch roof, closed the low tower face adjoining the transept, widened/thinned the upper paired belfry masonry, gave district towers solid arched panels and grounded both tower feet. Deeper cavity probes confirm that the upper chambers are open; the earlier filled appearance came from oversized piers/reveals, not loose interior faces. Rear and low-platform facades remain estimates.

The shared ashlar approximates the photographed horizontal masonry; exact marble coursing and stained-glass pictures are not bespoke textures. Skyline uses graph mean colors. Every graph reads once. Unload disposes geometry, leaves zero live model geometries and restores ground. Geographic-flat-terrain images show the signed map alignment; source-terrain views show approximate foundation/entry contact. Ground colors are diagnostic.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final Earth-lighting frames: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, silhouette, six details, four matched whole-model LODs and four transitions. Matched views include both complete towers/crosses, the church, stairs and low platform. Skyline keeps open four-post tower masses, clock blocks, shallow caps/crosses, main pitched roof/apse/transept, sparse porch piers and an inclined entry. District adds shared graphs, flat windows/doors/rose/clock fields, real porch arches and solid-pier arched tower panels. Street opens facade/rose/tower recesses and adds sparse pilasters/cornices/rails and steps. Closeup/master refine arch facets, rose spokes, corbels, clock marks and rail uprights. Curvature, openings, ornament and step profiles change visibly. The wider top belfry bays read open in current textured views. Swedish-cottage neighbors are synthetic context, not local mapped buildings.
